name: Pim de Witte
bio: Pim de Witte is the co-founder and CEO of General Intuition, the frontier lab for acting in space and time. He previously founded Medal, the world’s largest and fastest-growing platform for gaming clips, where millions of gamers share their best moments. Before gaming and AI, he worked with Médecins Sans Frontières and ran the largest Runescape private server at 14. General Intuition recently raised $650M+ from Khosla and General Catalyst.

sessions.title: Frontier Models for Acting in Space and Time
